title: Umbraco Cloud Health Checks Configuration
description: Configuration options for Umbraco Community Cloud Health Checks package

CloudHealthChecks.description: Configuration for Umbraco Cloud Health Checks

LocalTestMode.description: Enable local test mode to test health checks outside of Azure environment. When enabled, uses local paths for testing Azure and NuGet health checks.

BackgroundScan.description: Options for background folder size scanning

Enabled.description: Enable background folder size scanning. When enabled, folders are scanned periodically in the background and results are cached.

ScanIntervalHours.description: How often to scan folders in hours

CacheExpirationHours.description: How long to cache results in hours (30 days). Acts as a safety net if background scanning is disabled.

AzureStorage.description: Options for Azure Storage health check

WarningThresholdPercentage.description: Warning threshold percentage for storage usage

ErrorThresholdPercentage.description: Error threshold percentage for storage usage

NuGetCache.description: Options for NuGet Cache health check

WarningThresholdMb.description: Warning threshold in MB for NuGet cache size (default: 2560 MB / 2.5 GB)

ErrorThresholdMb.description: Error threshold in MB for NuGet cache size (default: 3072 MB / 3 GB)

UmbracoLogs.description: Options for Umbraco Logs health check

WarningThresholdMb.description: Warning threshold in MB for logs folder size

ErrorThresholdMb.description: Error threshold in MB for logs folder size

FileAgeWarningThresholdDays.description: Warning threshold in days for old log files

FileAgeErrorThresholdDays.description: Error threshold in days for old log files

LocalTemp.description: Options for Local Temp folder health check (D:\local in Azure Web Apps)

WarningThresholdPercentage.description: Warning threshold percentage for D:\local temp folder usage

ErrorThresholdPercentage.description: Error threshold percentage for D:\local temp folder usage
